items.source: Callback interface that can be used to customize retry settings used by RabbitTemplate.

items.source: Callback interface that can be used to customize retry settings used by message listeners.
items.translation: 可用于自定义消息监听器使用的重试设置的回调接口。

items.source: Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the EnvironmentBuilder to fine-tune its auto-configuration before it creates an Environment.
items.translation: 可被希望自定义 EnvironmentBuilder 以在创建 Environment 之前微调其自动配置的 Bean 实现的回调接口。

items.translation: 定义 RetryTemplate 的设置。

items.translation: AbstractConnectionFactory 的子类的配置器的基类。

items.source: Base class for configurers of sub-classes of AbstractRabbitListenerContainerFactory.
items.translation: AbstractRabbitListenerContainerFactory 的子类的配置器的基类。

items.source: Configures Rabbit CachingConnectionFactory with sensible defaults tuned using configuration properties.
items.translation: 配置 RabbitMQ 的CachingConnectionFactory，使用合理的默认值并通过配置属性进行调优。

items.source: Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the RabbitMQ ConnectionFactory to fine-tune its auto-configuration.

items.translation: 使用配置属性配置具有合理默认值的SimpleRabbitListenerContainerFactory。
